overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair's pre-meeting contacts did not involve a quorum of members, and the subcommittee was created and populated in a posted meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair appointed a memorial subcommittee on her own, without deliberation at a public meeting or input from other committee members.
allegations.key_passage: Here, any communications regarding potential subcommittee members were between the chair and the Superintendent, the Town Manager or residents, all of whom are not members of the Committee.
